issues.evidence: Inside the 'fix by hand' scene luma goes 53.5 (12.47) -> 104.6 (13.93) -> 39.9 (15.6) -> 52.7 (16.5): a 2x brightness jump and drop in 2.5 s.
issues.suggested_action: Pull the 13.93 Word shot down to luma ~55-60 with the same night grade (gain -0.9 stop, lift -0.02).

issues.evidence: Opening: luma 48 (0) -> 107.5 (1.2) -> 14.4 (4.5) -> 46.4 (5.07); sat 88 -> 31 -> 125 -> 118. The illustrated email reads as an ungraded grey-white plate before the teal office.
issues.suggested_action: Bring the 1.2 email to luma ~60, sat ~60, with the same cool lift as the office clip; let the rewind be the only exposure event.

issues.evidence: 'Done.' card at 9.8: luma 51, contrast 23.4 - all mid-grey, no black anywhere; same lifted haze on 16.5 (contrast 22.8) and 24.87 (21.5).
issues.suggested_action: Re-anchor blacks: levels black point +12, gamma 0.95, keep a vignette but let corners hit true black.

issues.evidence: Head-drop insert at 44.57: sat 145.6 vs 70.5 on the email before it and 102 on the logo after; 22.97 also sat 141.8.
issues.suggested_action: Desaturate the stock inserts ~30% (sat 0.7) and cap them at the problem-world mean (~90).

issues.evidence: Solution world splits between teal-navy bokeh product UI (luma 42-89, sat ~30-50) and candle-orange rooms (49.0 sat 96.6, 107.9 sat 140.3); 92.5 shows an orange smear bleeding into the navy UI shot.
issues.suggested_action: Tie them: carry a faint warm practical bloom into the product UI backgrounds (sat ~60) and pull the warm room down to sat ~100.

issues.evidence: Real UI pages run hot beside dark footage: 61.4 luma 72.5/contrast 75.8, 64.4 luma 88.4/contrast 90, 78.0 contrast 92.8 after 58.4 at luma 41.7.
issues.suggested_action: Roll off UI whites to ~85% (gain 0.88) and add the same screen softness as the laptop composites.

issues.evidence: Only shot with letterbox (22 rows, 2.2% of shots); no grain visible on product UI while stock carries texture.
issues.suggested_action: Remove the stray letterbox or apply 2.39 bars to every shot; add 3-4% grain to all UI shots.

issues.evidence: 117.5 frame is near-black with a barely visible line of text.
issues.suggested_action: Hold the struck line at readable contrast until the logo fades up.

constraint_failures.rule: hard grade jump inside one scene

top_revision: Normalise the problem world to one night grade (target luma 45-60, sat <=95, true blacks) so 1.2, 13.93 and the stock inserts stop jumping by 2x.

grade_recipe.problem_world_night: eq=brightness=-0.03:contrast=1.12:saturation=0.8, colorbalance=bs=0.06:bm=0.03:rh=-0.02, curves black point 0.04 out 0.0, vignette=PI/5, noise=alls=6:allf=t
grade_recipe.illustrated_ui_in_night: eq=gamma=0.92:contrast=1.2:saturation=0.6, colorlevels=rimax=0.85:gimax=0.85:bimax=0.88, then the same night balance + grain
